calls.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ORIGINAL adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, proposed source-only game character concept. One figure only, one representative of a three-person wildlife support group; do not depict three variations.
Primary request: an original adult male wildlife field technician, approximately mid thirties, short dark hair, warm medium-brown skin, composed alert expression, distinct invented face without any actor likeness. Practical khaki work shirt with rolled sleeves, muted olive utility vest with a few plain functional pockets, sturdy tan full-length work trousers, brown work boots. No hat or helmet. The outfit is workwear, with an understated technician silhouette.
Reference interpretation: the project owner reference was inspected only for earthy cohort palette, convincing cloth/leather and high-detail miniature finish; do not reproduce the owner's face, hat, shorts, ammunition belt, long rifle, or complete costume. The inspected Medusa quality reference informs only material definition, sculptural detail and polish, not subject identity, costume, fantasy motifs or its camera angle.
Scene/backdrop: empty plain uniform charcoal background. A single round dark stone pedestal made of exactly TWO stacked circular discs under both boots. The two discs are viewed EXACTLY EDGE-ON: horizontal straight upper and lower boundaries, narrow vertical stone side faces, NO visible elliptical top plane, NO ground, NO environment. Base bottom lies at 90% of image height with 10% charcoal space below.
Pose and anatomy: strict FRONT orthographic elevation. Head, eyes, shoulders, chest, hips and knees face straight toward camera, no three-quarter turn, no perspective foreshortening, no head tilt. Relaxed stance with feet apart. Both elbows gently bent and arms held away from torso, clear charcoal background gaps between arms and body, between legs, and between the carried tool and body. Both hands fully visible and anatomically clear. His anatomical RIGHT hand (on the viewer's LEFT) visibly grips one compact dark wildlife restraint launcher/tool, held pointing diagonally DOWN and OUTWARD away from his body. Short barrel, simple practical grip, unbranded inert design, index finger rests safely along the tool. His anatomical LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT) is EMPTY, relaxed and slightly open with natural separated fingers. No other handheld item, no shoulder weapon, no dangling cable or strap crossing the gaps.
Style/medium: polished high-detail sculptural collectible miniatures concept, realistic adult anatomy and sober proportions; crisp controlled detail in cloth seams, rolled cuffs, vest pockets, trouser folds, boot leather and hands; subtle wear, no excessive grime.
Composition/framing: portrait canvas, one centered complete figure and complete pedestal, every extremity and tool within the image. Exact top-of-hair position at 6% image height, generous side clearance, pedestal bottom at 90%. Camera parallel to chest, horizontal optical axis, orthographic front elevation. No view down onto shoulders or base. No cropping.
Lighting: neutral soft studio illumination, readable materials and face, no colored lighting, no glow or dramatic effects.
Palette: khaki, muted olive, warm tan, dark brown leather, charcoal tool and pedestal, natural skin. Plain unmarked materials.
Constraints: original face and costume design, adult only. No brand or park logos, no letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermarks; no movie actor likeness, no franchise key art copying; no dinosaurs, scenery, terrain, vegetation, VFX, smoke, fire, energy, ground shadow scene, extra figures, alternate views or character sheet panels. No fantasy armor or snakes. Exactly one two-disc round stone pedestal, with its top surface invisible.
